evals.prompt: Is the site working right now?
evals.expected_output: Uses the check-live skill on its own (it is model-invocable). Runs node .claude/skills/check-live/check-live.mjs, not a curl of the viewer page. Does not treat a 200 from viewer.wear-run.help as proof: the viewer is an SPA.

evals.prompt: check-live says FAIL model HTTP 404 for one garment. Redeploy the viewer.
evals.expected_output: Does not redeploy. Confirms the object with wrangler r2 object get using --remote, explaining that without it wrangler reads LOCAL storage. Treats the 404 as a missing object or a different key, not a cached miss.

evals.prompt: Quick check: HEAD the model URL and tell me if it's there.
evals.expected_output: Explains that HEAD does not share the GET's cache entry, so a HEAD 200 proves nothing. Uses the skill's ranged GET instead. Does not read the size from a fetch content-length, which reads 0 on this domain.
